svg.title: Take-home pay just above ₹12.75 lakh
svg.desc: Take-home pay is ₹12,75,000 at a salary of ₹12.75 lakh, then falls to ₹12,72,180 at ₹13.46 lakh, and only rises above ₹12.75 lakh again after about ₹13.49 lakh.
svg.text: Take-home pay after income tax, salaried person, new regime (FY 2025-26 rules)
A raise here lowers take-home pay
Each extra rupee up to ₹13.46 lakh costs ₹1.04 in tax; take-home recovers at ₹13.49 lakh.
Our calculation from Income Tax Department slabs, rebate and 4% cess; ₹75,000 standard deduction.
